items.title: Doug McDermott has officially retired from the NBA after 12 seasons.
items.author: Scott Agness
items.body_excerpt:
Doug McDermott has officially retired from the NBA after 12 seasons.

He was the 11th pick in 2014 — and spent a little more than three seasons with the Pacers.
